descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. Pasadena, Texas Responsibilities
• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)
• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department
• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods
• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts
• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man Qualifications: The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :
• Knowledge and understand of electro machinery repair.
• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.
• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.
• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.
• Must have 5 years or more of proven welding experience. Physical Demands:
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. What we offer you Paid parental leave Parental leave Health insurance 401(k) matching Paid time off Vision insurance Health savings account Dental insurance Gym membership Employee assistance program Disability insurance 401(k) 6% Match Paid holidays Wellness program Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
